name: grid

frames.best_why: All six frames look the same; frame 1 shows the full lined field and the centred heading.

tagline: Thin grey lines fade into black toward the corners.
summary: A near-black backdrop ruled with fine squares, softened at the border by a radial fade, with one gradient heading floating in the centre.
appearance: A black rectangle filled with a faint 40px lattice of thin grey lines, strongest in the middle and dying to pure black at the edges. A single large word, shaded from pale grey at the top to mid-grey below, sits centred.
behaviour: Static: nothing animates or responds. The ruling, the edge fade and the heading are drawn once and stay fixed.
demo_content: The word "Backgrounds" set as a large gradient heading.
search_phrases: dark page covered in thin squares
pattern that fades to black at edges
technical blueprint background for a hero
subtle lined wallpaper behind a headline
texture for a dark landing page
use_when: A dark landing or section needs quiet texture behind a headline without images or animation.
avoid_when: The page must stay light, or busy artwork already fills the hero and the lines would fight it.
customise: Takes no props. Heading text, square size, line opacity and the edge mask all live in the source, so changing them means editing the file.
weight_why: A couple of divs and plain CSS gradients; nothing animates or repaints.

a11y.note: A decorative backdrop with a text heading only; there is no control, so keyboard, focus and labels do not apply.

issues: Root hardcodes a black background, so it will not fit light themes.
The heading is baked into the component, not passed in.
polish_why: Even ruling and a smooth edge fade; contrast at the corners is low by design.
